route: The source evaluator constructs the actual argument vector for a genuine extension shim. The shim immediately delegates those same borrowed headers to Tcl_EvalObjv/Jim_EvalObjVector. No operand byte serialization, catch, eval rewrite or worker script compilation is attributed. Script setup and poststate use separate ordinary public evaluation channels.

observers.BIRTH: Genuine extension object original pointer, absent String, reference count and exact binary-decoded payload.
observers.EVENT: Reached genuine updateString callback, its original pointer/String-before/refs/payload and selected public global variable target/arr(k)/arr(m)/survivor presence and String residency. Jim array callback axes emit explicit NA because dictionary-sugar lookup could materialise a different original key; no absence claim is inferred. Observer calls only public non-error-reporting variable getters with resident names, never value String/eval/result publication. Its reads are actual observer effects, not a claim of an unobserved worker table state.
observers.ROW: Actual evaluation code/result hex and cumulative getter count, separated version/setup/worker/poststate phases. Public result capture can itself reach getters and remains inside the reported cumulative ROW count.
observers.unsupported: Every unavailable info default/array for/const worker remains an actual code/result row, including unreached lazy operands. No distribution-wide command availability or C/Jim equivalence is inferred.

source_bytes: Physical ASCII/LF probe; lazy payload bytes decoded from explicit hex. Persistent global original headers and pure Lists preserve operand ownership across setup and worker. Setup ends in resident READY; lookup context is the actual global frame and is separate from retained header ownership.
purpose_limits: No Native token/generation/header/cache/bytecode or compiled source equivalence from public rows.
No Runtime Host/refusal/Scope semantic proof from these original callbacks.
Refcounts/pointers are actual process observations only, with extension/public invocation owners retained explicitly.
Array/constant unsupported purposes and all Guest/setup/query failures remain explicit.
Poststate getters and their effects are separate from worker and internal callback observations.
BIG-IP remains not-tested; no C recipe donated to Jim.
